paite: Kaisaria ah mi khat amin Kornelia a-om a; amah Itali pawl achih uh, huai pawl a sepaih zaheutupa ahi.
heading: Peter Leh Kornelia
english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

paite: Amah Pathian limsakmi ahi a, a-inkuanpihte tengteng toh Pathian laudan asiam uhi, mite kiang ah thilthawnpiak tampi ape zel a, Pathian kiang ah leng athum gige hi.
english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

paite: Hiai mi'n sun dak kuana ding khawng in mengmuhna in Pathian angel khat akiang ah alut a, "Kornelia" chi a asap lai chiangtak in amu hi.
english: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

paite: Huan Kornelia in lau in amah ana en kilkel a, "Toupa, bang ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Na thumnate leh na thilpiakte theihgigena ding in Pathian ma ah atungtouta hi.
english: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

paite: Tu'n ah Joppa khua ah mi sawl inla, mi khat Simon Peter achih uh va pisak in;
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

paite: amah huai tuipi gei a om, savunbawlpa Simon inn a tung ahi a, ama'n na hih ding hon na hilh ding hi," achi hi.
english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

paite: Ahoupihpa angel apaitak in, Kornelia in asikhate lak a mi nih leh anek bawl gigete lak a Pathian limsak sepaih khat asam hi.
english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

paite: Thu tengteng akiang ua ahilh khit in Joppa khua ah asawlta hi.
english: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

paite: Huan azing nawn in, khopi zuan a pai, khua atun kuan un, thum ding in dak gukna vel in intung ah Peter akaltou hi.
heading: Peter Mengmuhna
english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

paite: Huan agil ahong kial mahmahta a, an nek a-utta hi; himahleh nek ding abawl lai un ihmu bang in zeel in ahong om hi.
english: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

paite: Van kihong in, banghiam bawm, puan liantak bang, ning li a khih, lei a luai a khaikhiak a om in amu hi.
english: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

paite: Huai sung ah leitung a khe li nei ganhing chi chih leh gamsa leh ganhing bokvak, tungleng vasa chichihte a-om uhi.
english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

paite: Huan akiang ah aw in, "Peter, thou in gou inla, ne in," achi hi.
english: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

paite: Himahleh Peter in, "Toupa hilou e; siang lou leh nin bangmah himhim ka ne ngei kei," achi hi.
english: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

paite: Aw in, anihveina in, “Pathian in ahihsiangthousa nang siang lou chi ke'n," achi hi.
english: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

paite: Huchibang ngen in thumvei ahong om a; huan van ah bawm khaitouh in a-om nawnta hi.
english: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

paite: Huan Peter in mengmu bang a amuh theisiam lou a, abuai lai in, Kornelia mi sawlte'n Simon inn ana kankhia ua,
english: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

paite: kongkhak bul ah ana dingh ua asam ua, "Simon, Peter achih uh, huai a atun leh tun louh," ana dong uhi.
english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

paite: Peter in mengmu bang a amuh angaihtuah lai inla, Kha in akiang ah, "Ngai in, mi thum in ahong zong uh.
english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.

paite: Huaiziak in thou inla, kumsuk in, bangmah ginglel lou in amaute zui in; amau ka sawl ahi uh," achi hi.
english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

paite: Huchi in Peter huai mite kiang ah ahohsukta a, akiang uah, "Ngai un na mizon uh ka hi; bang ahia na hong nasan uh?" achi hi.
english: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

paite: Amau, "Angel siangthou khat in, Kornelia, sepaih zaheutupa, midiktak, Pathian laudan siam, Juda nam tengteng lak a mihoih kiang ah, na thugen azakna ding in, a-inn ah nangmah sam ding in ahilh hi," achi uhi.
english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

paite: Huchi in mite asamlut a, agiaksakta hi. Huan azing in Peter athou a, akiang uah apai a, Joppa khomi unau kuate hiam leng akiang uah apai sam uhi.
english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

paite: Huan azing nawn in Kaisaria ah alutta uhi. Kornelia in, asanggamte leh alawm deihpente samkhawm in, amau ana ngak nilouh hi.
heading: Kornelia Inn Ah Peter
english: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

paite: Peter ahong lut dek laitak in Kornelia in ana dawn a, akhebul a bokkhup in, abia hi.
english: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

paite: Himahleh Peter in amah akaithou a, dingh in, "Kei leng mihing mai ka hi,” achi hi.
english: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

paite: Amah toh kihou kawm in alut a, mi tampi omkhawm amu hi.
english: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

paite: Akiang uah, "Juda mi namdang toh kithuah leh pai asianlouhdan noumau mah in na thei uhi; himahleh kuamah siang lou leh nin ka chih ding ahi kei chih Pathian in ahon theisak hi.
english: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

paite: Huaiziak in na hong saptak in sel lou in ka hong pai hi. Huchi in ka hon dong ahi, bangziak a hon sam na hi ua le?" achi hi.
english: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

paite: Huan Kornelia in, “Ni li ahita, tu hun bang tan in, ka inn ah, dak kuana hun thumna ah ka thum a; ngai in, ka ma ah puan vaktak silh mi khat ahong dingh a,
english: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

paite: 'Kornelia, na thumna zak in a-omta, mi kiang a na thilthawnpiakte leng Pathian in atheigige hi.
english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

paite: Huaiziak in Joppa ah Simon, Peter achih uh, sam ding in mi sawl inla, na kiang ah sam in; amah tuipi gei ah savunbawlpa Simon inn a tung ahi, amah ahong tun chiang in na kiang ah thu agen ding hi,' achi hi.
english: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

paite: Huaiziak in na kiang ah mi ka hon sawl pah hi; na hong pai ahoih ahi. Huchi in Toupa'n thu ahon piak peuhmah thei ding in tu'n ah Pathian mitmuh in i vek un hiai ah i om uhi," achi hi.
english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

paite: Huan Peter in agen a, "Pathian in mi deihsak tuam anei kei chih, diktak in ka thei hi.
heading: Kornelia Inn A Peter Thugen
english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

paite: Himahleh nam chih lak ah kuapeuh amah kihtakdan siam a, diktak a gamta peuhmah, apahtak mi ahi naknak uhi.
english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

paite: Ama'n khamuanna tanchinhoih, Jesu Khrist tungtawn in Israel suante kiang ah agen a (amah mi tengteng Toupa ahi),
english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

paite: Johan in atangkou pihpih baptisma nung in, hiai tanchinhoih, Galili gam a kipan ahong thang pan a, Judia gam tengteng ah athangsuak a, noumau leng na thei uhi.
english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

paite: Nazaret Jesu tungtang thu, huchi a Pathian in amah Kha Siangthou leh thilhihtheihna a athaunilhdan, Pathian akiang a a-om ziak in amah mi tung a thil hoih hih leh diabol gawt tengteng hihdam in avialvak vak hi.
english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

paite: Judate gam ah leh Jerusalem a athilhih tengteng theihpihte ka hi uh, amah sing dawn ah khai in athat uhi.
english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

paite: Amah Pathian in ani thum ni in akaithou nawn a, chiantak in akitheisak hi.
english: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

paite: Himahleh mi tengteng kiang ah ahi kei, Pathian in theihpih dia asehkholhte kiang kia ah ahi koute, misi lak a kipan athohnawn nung a akiang a ne a dawnte kiang ah.
english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

paite: Amah misi leh mihingte tung a Vaihawmpa dia Pathian seh ahi chih, mi kiang a tangkoupih leh theisak ding in Pathian in thu ahon pia hi.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

paite: Kuapeuh amah gingta amin ziak in khelhnate ngaihdam in a-om ding uh chih hiai a tanchin zawlnei tengteng in ana theihsak det uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

paite: Peter in huai thu agen laitak in thuzate tengteng tung ah Kha Siangthou ahong tung hi.
heading: Zentelte Tung A Kha Siangthou Tunna
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

paite: Zeksumte lak a agingtate Peter hon zui peuhmah in Kha Siangthou thawnniak Zentelte tung ah leng sunbuak ahih ziak in lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

paite: Paute a thu gen in Pathian phat in aza uhi.
english: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

paite: Huan Peter in apuang a, "Hiai mite, eimah bang a Kha Siangthou tang sam, baptisma ding in tui zat kuama'n akham thei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

paite: Huchi in Toupa min a baptisma tan ding thu apia hi. Huai khit in ni bangzah hiam taam ding in akhou uhi.
english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
